build_grammar_from_trees: build a grammar tree and vocabulary from a list of weighted parse trees using make_full_tree
linearize_tree_to_sequence: linearize a nested dictionary tree into a flat sequence of tokens and spans using tree_to_seq
convert_sequence_to_tree: convert a linearized token sequence back into a nested dictionary tree using seq_to_tree
tokenize_and_linearize: tokenize raw text with BPE and linearize a tree into a sequence using tokenize_linearize
collate_batch_tensors: collate a batch of text and tree pairs into padded PyTorch tensors using caip_collate
